status: fixed after H12 results were viewed and before H13 fits; development exploration
declaration: A separately named target extension, not a replacement for the approved next-close return experiment; retain SRT, forecast after close t and the original LSTM-fuzzy architecture if this screen advances
target: log(C_(t+1)/O_(t+1)), forecast using only information through close t; a position entered at the ex-date open does not earn that day's distribution
evaluation: the same original 378 development target dates; fail if any necessary open/close or historical baseline observation is missing; no date dropping
ridge: flatten the same 20x6 input; training-only input standardization and target scale without target centering; penalize all coefficients including intercept; mean SSE plus lambda norm squared
selection: last 15% of each outer training fold; also consider zero prediction with no fit; ties prefer zero then stronger shrinkage; refit on complete outer training
budget: two arms x three folds x (three inner ridge fits + at most one outer refit) = at most 24 fits
gate: an arm has >=1% lower pooled RMSE than the strongest of the four simple controls, wins >=2/3 folds against that control, and MAE is no more than 1% worse; only then specify matched LSTM/fuzzy training
boundary: new target RMSE is never compared numerically with close-to-close RMSE; no independent-test or trading-profit claim; do not compare only to zero if another simple control is stronger
stop: if neither arm passes, stop this intraday screen without new feature, parameter or neural searches
